what_it_does: Zettafly is a new layout for wiring together massive AI and scientific computing clusters where many jobs run simultaneously. The problem: existing wiring schemes can't guarantee that different jobs won't interfere with each other's data traveling through the network, causing slowdowns. Zettafly solves this by organizing the wiring into small non-blocking groups (guaranteed-clear paths within a group) connected through a simpler top layer. Any message between groups takes at most one hop through the top layer, keeping the network simple and fast. The paper tests this design against current industry standards using realistic workload simulations.
